verdict.rationale: Jira documents Rovo AI automatically assigning broken-down tasks to the right person, and Rovo AI building custom automation rules that move work forward. Together these cover part of AI-driven triage, but nothing shows AI classifying or prioritizing incoming bugs; the prioritization claim is generic and not tied to AI. Missing for 10: AI prioritization of incoming bugs/tasks, AI triage (severity/labeling/routing) of new intake, depth documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks

citations.quote: Breakdown big ideas into actionable tasks and automatically assign them to the right person with Rovo AI.
Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
